title: Pretty Except...
text: Pretty Except.... These towels are pretty but I returned them because a large label with the name of the company is sewed tightly across the front in a totally conspicuous place. No way to remove it. Sorry, but I wanted decorative hand towels to be decorative, not provide free advertising in my bathroom for the maker.
